name: Tillet
source:
Fianna's maid. She has cat ears and a tail. Her special talent is making tea. She was going to be a slave in the emperor's harem, but she caught Fianna's eye and was made to be her maid.

[Based on the [url=http://www.littlewitch.jp/home/special/LWRQ/pg115.html]official site[/url]]
